version.changelog: Add UTM attribution tags (utm_source=clawhub) to ClawLink branding links so visits from this skill page are tracked as a distinct traffic source.

llm.summary: This skill clearly sets up a Google Forms integration through ClawLink, with disclosed OAuth use and confirmation requirements for writes.

dimensions.detail: The requested Google Forms access is proportionate to the advertised integration, and the skill does not request unrelated local file, shell, memory, or broad system access beyond installing the needed plugin.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill installs and allowlists the external ClawLink plugin from ClawHub, then restarts the gateway. This is disclosed and coherent, but the artifact does not pin a plugin version or checksum.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The runtime instructions tell the agent to verify available tools, preview write actions, and require explicit user confirmation before create, update, or delete operations.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The plugin remains installed and allowlisted across sessions, and ClawLink stores OAuth tokens for the connected account. This persistence is disclosed and expected for a hosted integration.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Google Forms management, and the documented capabilities match that purpose: listing forms, reading responses, creating/updating forms, publishing settings, and watches.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Before installing, understand that this connects your Google account through ClawLink and enables tools that can read form data and, with confirmation, modify forms or responses. Use it only if you trust the ClawLink plugin and hosted OAuth service, and review write previews carefully before approving changes.
llm.findings: [T08] expected: The artifact does instruct installation and activation of an unpinned third-party ClawLink plugin. That is a real supply-chain caveat, but the behavior is disclosed, directly tied to the Google Forms integration, and not evidence of malicious activity in this skill artifact.
